title: Launch Gatekeeper: Prep Notes & Day-Of Checklist
notes:
Purpose: quick personal prep for the weekly release train gate review + concise day-of runbook. This is a scratchpad — distill into the slide deck and the final runbook after 11/07 meeting.

High-level objective:
- Decide: go/no-go on v2024.11 (hosting API improvements + Dedicated autoscale fix) by EOD Wednesday.
- If go, confirm rollout window, canary % and fallback plan.

Decision criteria (my condensed view for the gate):
1) Critical blocking bugs: 0 unresolved P0 across prod-facing services (serving-runtime, routing, auth).
2) Regression rate: <0.5% error increase on top-10 routes vs baseline (last 24h).
3) Infra capacity: Dedicated pool autoscale test successful (3 steady runs, no OOMs).
4) Observability: tracing and token-level cost metrics available and stored for 7 days for the canary cohort.
5) Rollback path validated and smoke-tested on staging.

Quick owner roster (who I ping during the gate):
- Release lead (me): Aisha Patel
- SRE on-call: Marcus Li (pager: #sre-oncall)
- Serving-runtime owner: Diego Chen
- Console / Rollouts owner: Sofia Ramirez
- QA lead: Priya Nair
- Customer success standby: Alex Torres

Risk heatmap (top 5 items, rapid notes):
- Autoscale regression: medium-high. Root cause patch merged but not long-running tested. Current mitigation: lower canary QPS, manual scale monitor. Owner: Marcus.
- Auth token flap on refresh endpoints: medium. Hotfix candidate in PR but needs load test. Owner: Diego.
- Observability retention misconfig: low-medium. Might impact postmortem speed. Owner: Sofia.
- Model variant mismatch on private deployments: low. Not in current canary cohort. Owner: release-ops.
- Deployment orchestration race (rare): medium. Additional guard added to rollout controller. Owner: Diego.

Meeting script (5–7 min gatekeeper summary to start the review):
- 0:00-0:30: Quick purpose + expected decision (go/no-go).
- 0:30-2:00: Read out current state for each decision criterion (P0s, regression, infra test, observability, rollback).
- 2:00-4:00: Owners call out known risks + mitigation readiness, state confidence (green/amber/red).
- 4:00-5:00: Vote and record attendees. Action owners and next steps if not-go.
- Optional: technical deep-dive after decision if needed.

Day-of quick runbook (one-line actionable items, in order):
1) Pre-window: ensure SRE console alerts are unmuted and escalation path confirmed (Marcus) — 30m before start.
2) Verify canary config matches approved hash (Console) — Sofia — 20m before.
3) Deploy canary to region us-west-2 at 10:00 UTC with 5% traffic — Release lead (Aisha).
4) Start smoke test suite on canary (QA) — Priya — run for 10m, report.
5) Monitor latency/error dashboards for 15m; if >0.5% regression, pause and escalate — Marcus.
6) After 30m stable, bump to 25% and run synthetic e2e flows — Diego.
7) Post-c anary: snapshot logs, tracing spans, token-cost report and store to /runbooks/2024.11/canary-snapshots — Sofia.
8) Full rollout window: scheduled at +3h if canary green. Confirm rollback window and tag release artifacts.

Fast rollback checklist (1-min):
- Toggle routing policy to previous model tag (Console) — Sofia.
- Revert autoscale policy to baseline config (infra) — Marcus.
- Re-run smoke tests to confirm baseline restored — QA.
- Open incident channel and assign severity if degraded beyond thresholds.

Pre-meeting prep items for me (Aisha):
- Pull last-24h error and latency diffs for top-10 routes (ask analytics for token-level breakdown). DUE: 11/06 EOD.
- Confirm autoscale stress test logs + OOM history (Marcus). DUE: 11/06.
- Validate canary config hash and point-in-time artifact list. DUE: 11/07 09:00 UTC.
- Update slide with visible metrics + gate decision template. DUE: 11/07 10:30 UTC.

Action items (from last sync + status):
- Diego: finalize auth refresh hotfix PR and run load job (PR#789) — in review, expected merge 11/06.
- Marcus: run 3x autoscale soak jobs and upload logs to GCS path runbooks/2024.11/autoscale-logs — in progress.
- Priya: expand smoke suite to include partial KV cache warm path — blocked by infra test assignment.
- Sofia: confirm observability retention flags are set for canary tenant — done.

Parking lot / open questions to raise in meeting:
- Do we have a plan for degraded cost visibility if token-count reporting lags? (impact: billing validation for canary customers)
- If rollback occurs, are CS and sales prepped with the customer-facing statement? Alex to confirm.
- Is there an agreed-upon SLA window for Dedicated customers during canary? Need product input.

Comms snippets (short, for updating channels):
- If go: "v2024.11 rolled to canary (5%) — monitoring. Expect update at +30m. Contact #release-ops for status."
- If no-go: "Decision: hold. Blocking items: [list]. Owners assigned, next update in 2h."

Notes to self: keep the gate short and decisive. Use the vote if there is disagreement (two vetoes -> hold). After gate, convert this doc into the official runbook and attach logs.

Recent edits history (personal):
- 2024-11-04: initial sketch of criteria + owners.
- 2024-11-06: added autoscale soak requirement, refined rollback steps.
- 2024-11-07: finalized meeting script, updated collaborator list.

End of scratchpad.
